items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: If you do the Revolutionary Ensemble with my friend Leroy Jenkins

ctx.x: You went from there to doing Forgotten Fantasies, which is a duo record.

I wanted to give me and Richie – right, and John said yes. We did it at Electric Ladyland, because me and Richie by then really had – it was the beginning of our – this harmonic thing we play, in the way we play. I want to get that on tape. He said sure. John was cool. Duo record, on a major label, trying to be commercial. I mean, look, he did the Revolutionary Ensemble. Come on. If you do the Revolutionary Ensemble with my friend Leroy Jenkins, I think you could do Dave Liebman and Richie playing Forgotten…
